'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|text=Bow to Brugsen Bursen at the Grand Exchange.
|notes=[[Brugsen Bursen]] is found inside the [[Grand Exchange]].
|map={{Map|3165,3478|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}}}

==Transportation==
*[[Varrock Teleport]] (directly to the [[Grand Exchange]] if the [[Medium Varrock Diary]] is completed).
*[[Ring of wealth]] teleport to the Grand Exchange.
*[[Spirit tree]] to the Grand Exchange.
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Cooks' Guild]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]] and use the [[Agility shortcut]] at the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange with 21 [[Agility]].
*[[Skull sceptre (i)]] and run east across the [[River Lum]].
*[[Chronicle]] and run north-west past [[Gertrude]].
